questions.question: Consider the continuous-time system $\dot q(t)=\begin{bmatrix}0&1\\0&0\end{bmatrix}q(t)+\begin{bmatrix}1\\1\end{bmatrix}u(t)$. What is the system description resulting from an exact discretization with sampling time $T_s$?
